scientific_integrity: Analytical proof covers all claimed dimensions, layers, and limits. Exact rational tests are finite corroboration, not infinite proof; independent assessment has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Canonical orthogonal degree-zero-plus-one Johnson projection only. The leading cross-cardinality asymptotic and unique sparse maximizer are proved; exact finite-n maximizing layers and lower-order terms are not determined. The full text of Elezovic (arXiv:2608.06232) was unavailable for complete bibliographic comparison; older equivalent calculations may exist.
title: Sparse-slice extremizers for affine Fourier projection on constant-weight layers
